reasoning_chain: Multiple callers (frontend and checkoutservice) show 100% errors calling currencyservice, indicating a converging error pattern on currencyservice.
The error rate on frontend->checkoutservice is also 100%, but checkoutservice->currencyservice is 100% errors, so frontend->checkoutservice errors are downstream propagation, not a separate fault.
currencyservice has no pods at all, confirming it is down and the root cause of the failure.
Other services on the critical path (productcatalogservice, cartservice) show no errors and low latency, so they are not the root cause.
Throughput collapsed to 15% of baseline, explaining missing edges but not indicating additional faults.
